text:
Yes. Satellite data detected **0.7 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2020**, about 0.02% of the property. The event meets the tool’s corroboration rule: the JRC 2020 reference mapped the entire event area as forest, and a later year was observed.

The 2021 national forest map classified 0.4 hectares of the event area as planted pine forest and 0.3 hectares as outside mapped forest; none was mapped as native forest.

An additional 1.3 hectares of loss occurred in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares, so it was not counted as an event.
